definitions.literal:
c2_accumulated_frame stackpointer p q n m =
    MAYCHANGE [RIP;RSP;RAX;RDI;RSI;RDX;R10;R11;RBX;RBP;R12] ,,
    MAYCHANGE SOME_FLAGS ,,
    MAYCHANGE [memory :> bytes(p,if c2_equal m p q n then n else 0);
               memory :> bytes(word_sub stackpointer (word 32),32)] ,,
    MAYCHANGE [events]
definitions.name: c2_accumulated_frame

definitions.literal:
c2_allowed_fetch xp ordinary a <=>
    xp a /\ ordinary a /\
    (assurance_region (word 0x22001120) 59 a \/
     assurance_region (word 0x22001030) 6 a \/
     assurance_region (word 0x22001040) 6 a \/
     assurance_region (word 0x10241840) 95 a \/
     assurance_region (word 0x102417d0) 97 a)
definitions.name: c2_allowed_fetch

definitions.literal:
c2_allowed_read rp ordinary stackpointer p q n a <=>
    rp a /\ ordinary a /\
    (assurance_region p n a \/ assurance_region q n a \/
     c2_scratch stackpointer a \/
     assurance_region stackpointer 8 a \/
     assurance_region (word 0x22003fd0) 8 a \/
     assurance_region (word 0x22003fd8) 8 a)
definitions.name: c2_allowed_read

definitions.literal:
c2_allowed_write wp ordinary stackpointer p q n m a <=>
    wp a /\ ordinary a /\
    ((c2_equal m p q n /\ assurance_region p n a) \/
     c2_scratch stackpointer a)
definitions.name: c2_allowed_write

definitions.literal:
c2_before_cleanup_frame stackpointer =
    MAYCHANGE [RIP;RSP;RAX;RDI;RSI;RDX;R10;R11;RBX;RBP;R12] ,,
    MAYCHANGE SOME_FLAGS ,,
    MAYCHANGE [memory :> bytes(word_sub stackpointer (word 32),32)] ,,
    MAYCHANGE [events]
definitions.name: c2_before_cleanup_frame

definitions.literal:
c2_branch_header_post p q n m (returned:x86state) (t:x86state) <=>
    read RIP t=(if c2_equal m p q n then word 0x22001148 else word 0x2200113a) /\
    read R12 t=(if c2_equal m p q n then word 1 else word 0) /\
    read RSP t=read RSP returned /\ read RAX t=read RAX returned /\
    read RBX t=read RBX returned /\ read RBP t=read RBP returned /\
    read R13 t=read R13 returned /\ read R14 t=read R14 returned /\ read R15 t=read R15 returned /\
    read DF t=read DF returned /\ read memory t=read memory returned /\
    (MAYCHANGE [RIP;R12] ,, MAYCHANGE SOME_FLAGS ,, MAYCHANGE [events]) returned t
definitions.name: c2_branch_header_post
c2_caller_mc

definitions.literal:
c2_cleanse_completed lib_file stackpointer p q n m rp wp xp ordinary
    (initial:x86state) a (returned:x86state) <=>
    ?entry:x86state.
      c2_cleanse_ready lib_file stackpointer p q n m rp wp xp ordinary initial a entry /\
      bp_e2_cleanse_call_post 0x102417d0 (word_sub stackpointer (word 32))
        (word 0x22001153) p n (read memory entry) entry returned
definitions.name: c2_cleanse_completed

definitions.literal:
c2_cleanse_plt_prefix:byte list =
   [word 0xff;word 0x25;word 0x92;word 0x2f;word 0x00;word 0x00]
definitions.name: c2_cleanse_plt_prefix

definitions.literal:
c2_cleanse_ready lib_file stackpointer p q n m rp wp xp ordinary
    (initial:x86state) a (entry:x86state) <=>
    c2_equal m p q n /\
    bp_e2_cleanse_public_pre lib_file (read memory entry) (read memory entry)
      (word_sub stackpointer (word 32)) (word 0x22001153) p n
      (read memory entry) rp wp xp ordinary (entry,a) /\
    c2_saved_prefix stackpointer p q n m initial entry /\
    read R12 entry=word 1 /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 stackpointer) entry=
      read (memory :> bytes64 stackpointer) initial /\
    c2_before_cleanup_frame stackpointer initial entry
definitions.name: c2_cleanse_ready

definitions.literal:
c2_crypto_completed lib_file stackpointer p q n m rp wp xp ordinary
    (initial:x86state) a (returned:x86state) <=>
    ?entry:x86state.
      c2_crypto_ready lib_file stackpointer p q n m rp wp xp ordinary initial a entry /\
      bp_assurance_call_post 0x10241840 (word_sub stackpointer (word 32))
        (word 0x22001132) p q n (read events entry) (read memory entry) entry returned
definitions.name: c2_crypto_completed

definitions.literal:
c2_crypto_plt_prefix:byte list =
   [word 0xff;word 0x25;word 0x9a;word 0x2f;word 0x00;word 0x00]
definitions.name: c2_crypto_plt_prefix

definitions.literal:
c2_crypto_public_frame =
    MAYCHANGE [RIP;RSP;RAX;RDI;RSI;RDX;R10;R11] ,,
    MAYCHANGE SOME_FLAGS ,, MAYCHANGE [events]
definitions.name: c2_crypto_public_frame

definitions.literal:
c2_crypto_ready lib_file stackpointer p q n m rp (wp:num->bool) xp
    ordinary (s:x86state) a (t:x86state) <=>
    bp_e2_crypto_public_pre lib_file (read memory t) (read memory t)
      (word_sub stackpointer (word 32)) (word 0x22001132) p q n
      (read memory t) rp xp ordinary (t,a) /\
    c2_saved_prefix stackpointer p q n m s t /\
    read R12 t=word 0 /\ c2_prefix_frame stackpointer s t
definitions.name: c2_crypto_ready

definitions.literal:
c2_entry_witness lib_file client_file p q n k different <=>
    ?lib_rw lib_padding client_rw client_padding m rp wp xp ordinary s a.
      c2_pre lib_file lib_rw lib_padding client_file client_rw client_padding
        (word 0x300008) (word 0x400000) p q n m rp wp xp ordinary (s,a) /\
      (!i. i<n ==> m(word_add p (word i))=
        (if different /\ i=k then word 255 else word 128)) /\
      (!i. i<n ==> m(word_add q (word i))=word 128) /\
      (p=word 0 /\ q=word 0 /\ n=0 ==> ~rp 0)
definitions.name: c2_entry_witness

definitions.literal:
c2_equal (m:int64->byte) (p:int64) (q:int64) n <=>
    !i. i<n ==> m(word_add p (word i))=m(word_add q (word i))
definitions.name: c2_equal

definitions.literal:
c2_file_code (file_bytes:num->byte) <=>
    (!i. i<59 ==> file_bytes(0x1120+i)=EL i c2_caller_mc) /\
    (!i. i<6 ==> file_bytes(0x1030+i)=EL i c2_crypto_plt_prefix) /\
    (!i. i<6 ==> file_bytes(0x1040+i)=EL i c2_cleanse_plt_prefix)
definitions.name: c2_file_code

definitions.literal:
c2_frame stackpointer p q n m =
    MAYCHANGE [RIP;RSP;RAX;RDI;RSI;RDX;R10;R11] ,,
    MAYCHANGE SOME_FLAGS ,,
    MAYCHANGE [memory :> bytes(p,if c2_equal m p q n then n else 0);
               memory :> bytes(word_sub stackpointer (word 32),32)] ,,
    MAYCHANGE [events]
definitions.name: c2_frame

definitions.literal:
c2_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding (m:int64->byte) <=>
    !a. c2_image_domain (val a)
        ==> m a = c2_reference_image file_bytes initial_rw padding a
definitions.name: c2_full_image

definitions.literal:
c2_got (s:x86state) <=>
    read (memory :> bytes64 (word 0x22003fd0)) s=word 0x10241840 /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 (word 0x22003fd8)) s=word 0x102417d0
definitions.name: c2_got

definitions.literal:
c2_header_completed lib_file stackpointer p q n m rp wp xp ordinary
    (initial:x86state) a (t:x86state) <=>
    ?returned:x86state.
      c2_crypto_completed lib_file stackpointer p q n m rp wp xp ordinary
        initial a returned /\ c2_branch_header_post p q n m returned t
definitions.name: c2_header_completed

definitions.literal: c2_initialized_rw a <=> 0x22003da8 <= a /\ a < 0x22004010
definitions.name: c2_initialized_rw

definitions.literal:
c2_loaded_code (s:x86state) <=>
    bytes_loaded s (word 0x22001120) c2_caller_mc /\
    bytes_loaded s (word 0x22001030) c2_crypto_plt_prefix /\
    bytes_loaded s (word 0x22001040) c2_cleanse_plt_prefix /\
    bytes_loaded s (word 0x10241840) crypto_memcmp_mc /\
    bytes_loaded s (word 0x102417d0) openssl_cleanse_mc
definitions.name: c2_loaded_code

definitions.literal:
c2_middle_frame stackpointer =
    MAYCHANGE [RIP;RSP;RDI;RSI] ,,
    MAYCHANGE [memory :> bytes(word_sub stackpointer (word 32),32)] ,,
    MAYCHANGE [events]
definitions.name: c2_middle_frame

definitions.literal:
c2_middle_ready stackpointer p q n m (initial:x86state) (returned:x86state) <=>
    c2_equal m p q n /\
    c2_saved_prefix stackpointer p q n m initial returned /\
    read RIP returned=word 0x22001148 /\
    read RSP returned=word_sub stackpointer (word 24) /\
    read R12 returned=word 1 /\
    read DF returned=F /\ ~bit 18(read rflags returned) /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 stackpointer) returned=
      read (memory :> bytes64 stackpointer) initial /\
    c2_before_cleanup_frame stackpointer initial returned
definitions.name: c2_middle_ready

definitions.literal:
c2_pre lib_file lib_rw lib_padding client_file client_rw
    client_padding stackpointer ra p q n m rp wp xp ordinary
    (s:x86state,a:abi_omitted_state) <=>
    n<2 EXP 64 /\ 32<=val(stackpointer:int64) /\
    val stackpointer MOD 16=8 /\ val stackpointer+8<2 EXP 64 /\
    assurance_canonical48(val(ra:int64)) /\ ~(ra=word 0x22001120) /\
    read RIP s=word 0x22001120 /\ read RSP s=stackpointer /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 stackpointer) s=ra /\
    C_ARGUMENTS [p;q;word n] s /\ read memory s=m /\
    read DF s=F /\ ~bit 18(read rflags s) /\ e5_normal_flags s /\
    assurance_canonical48(val(read ABI_FS_BASE a)) /\
    fb_file_code lib_file /\ clw_file_code lib_file /\
    fb_full_image lib_file lib_rw lib_padding m /\
    c2_file_code client_file /\
    c2_full_image client_file client_rw client_padding m /\
    c2_loaded_code s /\ c2_got s /\
    (!addr. lw_image_domain addr ==>
       rp addr /\ ordinary addr /\ (xp addr <=> lw_execute addr) /\
       (wp addr <=> lw_image_write addr)) /\
    (!addr. c2_image_domain addr ==>
       rp addr /\ ordinary addr /\
       (xp addr <=> c2_image_execute addr) /\
       (wp addr <=> c2_image_write addr)) /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. rp a /\ ordinary a) (val p) n /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. rp a /\ ordinary a) (val q) n /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. wp a /\ ordinary a) (val p) n /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. rp a /\ ordinary a) (val stackpointer-32) 32 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. wp a /\ ordinary a) (val stackpointer-32) 32 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. rp a /\ ordinary a) (val stackpointer) 8 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. rp a /\ ordinary a) 0x22003fd0 8 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. rp a /\ ordinary a) 0x22003fd8 8 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. xp a /\ ordinary a) 0x22001120 59 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. xp a /\ ordinary a) 0x22001030 6 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. xp a /\ ordinary a) 0x22001040 6 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. xp a /\ ordinary a) 0x10241840 95 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. xp a /\ ordinary a) 0x102417d0 97 /\
    (!addr. ~(assurance_region p n addr /\
               c2_scratch stackpointer addr)) /\
    (!addr. ~(assurance_region q n addr /\
               c2_scratch stackpointer addr)) /\
    (!addr. ~(assurance_region p n addr /\
               assurance_region stackpointer 8 addr))
definitions.name: c2_pre

definitions.literal:
c2_prefix_frame stackpointer =
    MAYCHANGE [RIP;RSP;RBX;RBP;R12] ,, MAYCHANGE SOME_FLAGS ,,
    MAYCHANGE [memory :> bytes(word_sub stackpointer (word 32),32)] ,,
    MAYCHANGE [events]
definitions.name: c2_prefix_frame

definitions.literal:
c2_public_post stackpointer ra p q n m s a
    (t:x86state#abi_omitted_state) <=>
    c2_scalar_post stackpointer ra p q n m s (FST t) /\
    SND t=a /\ abi_required_controls_preserved a (SND t)
definitions.name: c2_public_post

definitions.literal:
c2_reference_image (file_bytes:num->byte)
     (initial_rw:int64->byte) (padding:int64->byte) (a:int64) =
    if c2_immutable (val a)
    then file_bytes (val a - 0x22000000)
    else if c2_initialized_rw (val a) then initial_rw a
    else padding a
definitions.name: c2_reference_image

definitions.literal:
c2_saved_prefix stackpointer p q n m (s:x86state) t <=>
    read RBX t=p /\ read RBP t=word n /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 (word_sub stackpointer (word 8))) t=read R12 s /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 (word_sub stackpointer (word 16))) t=read RBP s /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 (word_sub stackpointer (word 24))) t=read RBX s /\
    (!addr. ~c2_scratch stackpointer (val addr)
            ==> read memory t addr=m addr) /\
    (!i. i<n ==> read memory t (word_add p (word i))=m(word_add p (word i))) /\
    (!i. i<n ==> read memory t (word_add q (word i))=m(word_add q (word i))) /\
    c2_loaded_code t /\ c2_got t
definitions.name: c2_saved_prefix

definitions.literal:
c2_scalar_post stackpointer ra p q n m (s:x86state) t <=>
    read RIP t=ra /\ val(read RSP t)=val(stackpointer:int64)+8 /\
    read RAX t=(if c2_equal m p q n then word 1 else word 0) /\
    (c2_equal m p q n
       ==> !i. i<n ==> read memory t (word_add p (word i))=word 0) /\
    (!addr. ~((c2_equal m p q n /\ assurance_region p n (val addr)) \/
               c2_scratch stackpointer (val addr))
            ==> read memory t addr=m addr) /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 stackpointer) t=ra /\
    read RBX t=read RBX s /\ read RBP t=read RBP s /\
    read R12 t=read R12 s /\ read R13 t=read R13 s /\
    read R14 t=read R14 s /\ read R15 t=read R15 s /\
    read DF t=F /\ c2_loaded_code t /\ c2_got t /\
    c2_frame stackpointer p q n m s t
definitions.name: c2_scalar_post

definitions.literal:
c2_scratch (stackpointer:int64) a <=>
    assurance_region (word_sub stackpointer (word 32)) 32 a
definitions.name: c2_scratch

definitions.literal:
c2_segment_policy stackpointer p q n m rp wp xp ordinary
    (remaining:num) (source:x86state) (target:x86state) <=>
    assurance_step_policy
      (c2_allowed_read rp ordinary stackpointer p q n)
      (c2_allowed_write wp ordinary stackpointer p q n m)
      (c2_allowed_fetch xp ordinary) source target /\
    abi_all_decodes_caller_scalar source
definitions.name: c2_segment_policy

definitions.literal:
c2_step_policy stackpointer p q n m rp wp xp ordinary
    (remaining:num) (source:x86state) (target:x86state) <=>
    assurance_step_policy
      (c2_allowed_read rp ordinary stackpointer p q n)
      (c2_allowed_write wp ordinary stackpointer p q n m)
      (c2_allowed_fetch xp ordinary) source target /\
    (remaining=1 ==> assurance_actual_ret 1 source target) /\
    abi_all_decodes_caller_scalar source
definitions.name: c2_step_policy

definitions.literal:
c2_steps p q n m =
    if c2_equal m p q n
    then 20 + bp_assurance_call_steps n + cleanse_functional_steps p n
    else 16 + bp_assurance_call_steps n
definitions.name: c2_steps

definitions.literal:
c2_suffix_post stackpointer ra p q n m (initial:x86state) (returned:x86state) (t:x86state) <=>
    read RIP t=ra /\ read RSP t=word_add stackpointer (word 8) /\
    read RAX t=(if c2_equal m p q n then word 1 else word 0) /\
    read RBX t=read RBX initial /\ read RBP t=read RBP initial /\ read R12 t=read R12 initial /\
    read R13 t=read R13 returned /\ read R14 t=read R14 returned /\ read R15 t=read R15 returned /\
    read DF t=read DF returned /\ read memory t=read memory returned /\
    (MAYCHANGE [RIP;RSP;RAX;RBX;RBP;R12] ,, MAYCHANGE [events]) returned t
definitions.name: c2_suffix_post

definitions.literal:
c2_suffix_pre stackpointer ra p q n m rp wp xp ordinary (initial:x86state) (returned:x86state) <=>
    32<=val(stackpointer:int64) /\ val stackpointer+8<2 EXP 64 /\
    bytes_loaded returned (word 0x22001120) c2_caller_mc /\
    read RIP returned=(if c2_equal m p q n then word 0x22001153 else word 0x2200113a) /\
    read RSP returned=word_sub stackpointer (word 24) /\
    read R12 returned=(if c2_equal m p q n then word 1 else word 0) /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 (word_sub stackpointer (word 24))) returned=read RBX initial /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 (word_sub stackpointer (word 16))) returned=read RBP initial /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 (word_sub stackpointer (word 8))) returned=read R12 initial /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 stackpointer) returned=ra /\
    assurance_span_ok (c2_allowed_read rp ordinary stackpointer p q n)
      (val stackpointer-32) 32 /\
    assurance_span_ok (c2_allowed_read rp ordinary stackpointer p q n)
      (val stackpointer) 8 /\
    assurance_span_ok (c2_allowed_fetch xp ordinary) 0x22001120 59
definitions.name: c2_suffix_pre

definitions.literal: c2w_execute a <=> lw_execute a \/ c2_image_execute a
definitions.name: c2w_execute

definitions.literal: c2w_external a <=> 0x50000000 <= a /\ assurance_canonical48 a
definitions.name: c2w_external

definitions.literal:
c2w_layout (p:int64) (q:int64) n k different <=>
    n<2 EXP 64 /\ assurance_span_ok c2w_external (val p) n /\
    assurance_span_ok c2w_external (val q) n /\
    (different ==> k<n /\
      !i. i<n ==> ~(word_add q (word i)=word_add p (word k)))
definitions.name: c2w_layout

definitions.literal:
c2w_memory lib_file client_file p k different =
    write (bytes64 (word 0x300008)) (word 0x400000)
      (write (bytes64 (word 0x22003fd0)) (word 0x10241840)
        (write (bytes64 (word 0x22003fd8)) (word 0x102417d0)
          (c2w_seed lib_file client_file p k different)))
definitions.name: c2w_memory

definitions.literal: c2w_ordinary a <=> assurance_canonical48 a
definitions.name: c2w_ordinary

definitions.literal: c2w_read a <=> assurance_canonical48 a /\ ~(a=0)
definitions.name: c2w_read
c2w_seed

definitions.literal:
c2w_state lib_file client_file p q n k different =
    x86state_RECORD (word 0x22001120)
      (\j:(4)word. if j=word 7 then p else if j=word 6 then q
                    else if j=word 2 then word n
                    else if j=word 4 then word 0x300008 else word 0)
      (\j:(5)word. word 0) (\j:(3)word. word 0) (word 2)
      (c2w_memory lib_file client_file p k different) []
definitions.name: c2w_state

definitions.literal:
c2w_write a <=>
    if lw_image_domain a then lw_image_write a
    else if c2_image_domain a then c2_image_write a
    else assurance_canonical48 a
definitions.name: c2w_write

definitions.literal:
e5_normal_flags (s:x86state) <=>
    ~bit 16 (read rflags s) /\ ~bit 8 (read rflags s)
definitions.name: e5_normal_flags

definitions.literal: e5_rf_clear (s:x86state) = write (rflags :> bitelement 16) F s
definitions.name: e5_rf_clear

definitions.literal:
e5_rf_retired_step (s:x86state) t <=>
    ?u. x86 s u /\ t=e5_rf_clear u
definitions.name: e5_rf_retired_step

definitions.literal:
e5_rf_retired_extended_step (s:x86state,a:abi_omitted_state) t <=>
    ?u b. abi_caller_scalar_extended_step (s,a) (u,b) /\
          t=(e5_rf_clear u,b)
definitions.name: e5_rf_retired_extended_step

definitions.literal:
e5_normal_step_policy (C:num->x86state->x86state->bool) k s t <=>
    C k s t /\ e5_normal_flags s /\ e5_normal_flags t
definitions.name: e5_normal_step_policy

definitions.literal:
e5_normal_environment long_mode cpl (dr7:int64) cet_enabled
      external_event_delivered debug_agent_modified <=>
    long_mode /\ cpl=3 /\
    (!i. i<8 ==> ~bit i dr7) /\ ~cet_enabled /\
    ~external_event_delivered /\ ~debug_agent_modified
definitions.name: e5_normal_environment

definitions.literal:
(e5_rf_checked_run 0 (P:x86state->bool)
      (C:num->x86state->x86state->bool) s <=> P s) /\
  (e5_rf_checked_run (SUC n) P C s <=>
     (?t. e5_rf_retired_step s t) /\
     !t. e5_rf_retired_step s t ==> C (SUC n) s t /\
                                      e5_rf_checked_run n P C t)
definitions.name: e5_rf_checked_run

objects.literal:
!lib_file lib_rw lib_padding client_file client_rw client_padding
    stackpointer ra p q n m rp wp xp ordinary s a.
    c2_pre lib_file lib_rw lib_padding client_file client_rw client_padding
      stackpointer ra p q n m rp wp xp ordinary (s,a)
    ==> assurance_checked_run (c2_steps p q n m)
      (c2_scalar_post stackpointer ra p q n m s)
      (c2_step_policy stackpointer p q n m rp wp xp ordinary) s
objects.name: C2_CALLER_CHECKED

objects.literal:
!p q n m. c2_steps p q n m =
    if c2_equal m p q n
    then 20 + (if n=0 then 6 else if n=16 then 15 else 7*n+10)
            + cleanse_functional_steps p n
    else 16 + (if n=0 then 6 else if n=16 then 15 else 7*n+10)
objects.name: C2_CALLER_COUNT

objects.literal:
!lib_file lib_rw lib_padding client_file client_rw client_padding
    stackpointer ra p q n m rp wp xp ordinary s a.
    c2_pre lib_file lib_rw lib_padding client_file client_rw client_padding
      stackpointer ra p q n m rp wp xp ordinary (s,a)
    ==> assurance_checked_run 8
      (c2_crypto_ready lib_file stackpointer p q n m rp wp xp ordinary s a)
      (c2_segment_policy stackpointer p q n m rp wp xp ordinary) s
objects.name: C2_INITIAL_COMPARE_HANDOFF

objects.literal:
!lib_file lib_rw lib_padding client_file client_rw client_padding
    stackpointer ra p q n m rp wp xp ordinary s a.
    c2_pre lib_file lib_rw lib_padding client_file client_rw client_padding
      stackpointer ra p q n m rp wp xp ordinary (s,a)
    ==> eventually_n abi_caller_scalar_extended_step (c2_steps p q n m)
      (c2_public_post stackpointer ra p q n m s a) (s,a)
objects.name: C2_CALLER_INTERFACE

objects.literal:
!lib_file lib_rw lib_padding client_file client_rw client_padding
    stackpointer ra p q n m rp wp xp ordinary s a.
    c2_pre lib_file lib_rw lib_padding client_file client_rw client_padding
      stackpointer ra p q n m rp wp xp ordinary (s,a)
    ==> assurance_checked_run (c2_steps p q n m)
      (\t. c2_scalar_post stackpointer ra p q n m s t /\ e5_normal_flags t)
      (e5_normal_step_policy
        (c2_step_policy stackpointer p q n m rp wp xp ordinary)) s
objects.name: C2_CALLER_NORMAL_CHECKED

objects.literal:
!lib_file lib_rw lib_padding client_file client_rw client_padding
    stackpointer ra p q n m rp wp xp ordinary s a.
    c2_pre lib_file lib_rw lib_padding client_file client_rw client_padding
